temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary has been working excessively long hospital hours, skipping meals and sleep. Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines because of hospital workload.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was dedicated but jeopardizing his health through overwork, likely due to hospital demands; he did not know any deeper cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's refusal confirms he is heavily bound by work and unwilling or unable to prioritize rest.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is overworked and resistant to taking a break; he may need persistent concern and support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and worried, with some disappointment.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To keep encouraging Gary to rest and find a way to help him reduce work stress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes that Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary's overwork was primarily due to hospital obligations and that Gary was reluctant to take a break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's restlessness and avoidance suggest there may be hidden personal issues beyond professional obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is likely burdened by something deeper and needs a chance to open up.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Gary gently and encourage him to share what is really going on.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspected Gary was hiding deeper problems behind overwork and wanted to help without judgment.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's disclosure confirms that the overwork stems from new-department pressure and personal challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's actions are understandable, and he needs practical support to rebalance work and life.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule for better balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in and learns Gary is making efforts, reporting progress while still facing challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary needed sustained support and practical guidance to maintain a healthier balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's progress shows he is actively changing and that Ethan's support is helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is improving and can continue to improve with encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, offering support, and encouraging Gary.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Ethan learns Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and can manage on his own.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was making progress but might still benefit from support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary has achieved a stable, healthier balance and no longer needs active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is self-sufficient and in control; Ethan can step back while remaining available.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfied and happy for his friend.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back and let Gary manage independently, while letting him know he can call if needed.
